answer: Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 2 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the whisper check. Bindings are kept in canyon, verified in anchor, and the chain is public. A farm generating text without memory of its own history thus fails the binding, which means it has to store and read state per alias. That bill is paid per identity, so 398 aliases cost 183 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
